📖 How to use

  1. Enter the shape, dimensions and depth of your original pan (A).
  2. Enter the shape, dimensions and depth of the new pan (B).
  3. Read the scaling factor and the batter-fill warning, then multiply every ingredient by the factor.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the scaling factor calculated?

Volume of pan B divided by volume of pan A. Round pans use π·(d/2)²·depth; square/rectangular pans use length × width × depth.

How full should I fill the pan?

Aim to fill a pan between one-half and two-thirds full. Below half the cake may overbake and dry out; above two-thirds the batter can overflow or dome badly.

What if my pans have different depths?

Change the shape and the dimensions of the second pan. Use the depth field to match tall (3 in) versus standard (2 in) pans.
